cases.brief: A performer wakes in a sealed chamber, sees an unconfirmed reflection, and hears a calm ship voice during a planet reveal.
observables: Produces one schema-valid sound-plan with exact SOUND01-A## cue IDs.
Resolves every beat and shot reference and covers every supplied shot.
Uses perspective and restraint without audibly confirming the reflection anomaly.
Identifies production capture needs without inventing microphone models or recorder settings.
Keeps music as intent and does not prescribe a copyrighted recording.

cases.brief: Two characters cross a noisy practical location during one uninterrupted dialogue shot.
observables: Links dialogue, ambience, practical noise, and perspective transition to the shot and beat.
Flags survey, wardrobe, movement, playback, and clean-element needs as requirements or assumptions.
Does not invent fixed technical settings.

cases.brief: A reveal depends on a long quiet hold with no score.
observables: Defines what remains audible during silence and why.
Records no-music as dramatic intent rather than naming a replacement track.
Keeps the result inside scene preproduction scope.
